nodes.title: ADR 0048: Copy App process and schedule definitions into AppInstances

description:
The agent can inspect and edit App process and schedule definitions through typed HTTP operations and Orbit commands.

## Scope

* In: PHP SDK requests and responses plus CLI definition commands and their public guidance.
* Out: remote execution, applying edits to existing instance copies, and automatic worker or timer startup.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Typed clients implement list, create, show, replace, and remove for both App definition kinds with bounded immutable responses and exact Gateway request fields. Proof: `packages/php-sdk/tests/Unit/Requests/Apps/RuntimeDefinitionRequestsTest.php`.
- [ ] `app:process-definitions APP` and `app:schedule-definitions APP` list definitions; matching singular `app:process-definition` and `app:schedule-definition` commands use `--id=UUID` to show, `--file=PATH` to create, both to replace, or `--id=UUID --remove` to delete, with incompatible combinations refused before HTTP. Proof: `apps/cli/tests/Feature/Apps/RuntimeDefinitionCommandsTest.php`.
- [ ] Human and JSON output preserve request IDs and safe errors; list output omits commands, file content is submitted without local execution, and operation guidance explains that existing copies require explicit instance-level remove/add changes. Proof: `apps/cli/tests/Feature/Apps/RuntimeDefinitionCommandsTest.php`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes App definition commands and file examples, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd packages/php-sdk && composer check`, `cd apps/cli && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
title: Expose App runtime definitions through the SDK and CLI
